Catorce parámetros que definen si un sal: Fourteen parameters that decide whether a salmon grows or gets sick: what they are, which range to work in, when they become critical, how to control them and how they affect each other. In recirculation nothing moves alone: feed generates TAN, CO₂ and solids, and the biofilter consumes oxygen and alkalinity.
Son referencias de literatura y práctica: They are literature and RAS practice references for salmonids, not legal or universal limits. They change with life stage (egg, alevin, smolt), temperature, hardness and salinity.

Nitrospira y Nitrobacter. Consume 1,14 g: Nitrospira and Nitrobacter. Consumes 1.14 g O₂ per g N. They are more sensitive to sudden changes: when they fail, a nitrite peak appears.
Sin contar biomasa: 4,57 g O₂ y 7,14 g C: Excluding biomass: 4.57 g O₂ and 7.14 g CaCO₃ per g N. With cell synthesis (Ebeling et al. 2006): 4.18 g O₂, 7.05 g CaCO₃, 5.85 g CO₂ and ~0.20 g biomass. Some Nitrospira (comammox) perform both steps.
El O₂ debe atravesar la biopelícula. Con: O₂ has to cross the biofilm. With high TAN or a thick biofilm, oxygen becomes limiting before ammonia does.
Bajo 6,5 la tasa cae fuerte. Bajar el pH: Below 6.5 the rate drops sharply. Lowering pH to reduce NH₃ costs biofilter capacity.
Summerfelt et al. (2015) midieron mejor: Summerfelt et al. (2015) measured better TAN removal at 70–200 than at 10 mg/L in MBBRs.
En agua fría las tasas son menores y la: In cold water rates are lower and start-up slower. Sudden changes matter more than the absolute value.
Subidas abruptas de salinidad inhiben la: Abrupt salinity increases inhibit nitrification, especially nitrite oxidation (Kinyage et al. 2019). Raise it in stages.
Con más carbono orgánico, las heterótrof: With more organic carbon, heterotrophs grow faster and displace nitrifiers. Remove solids before the biofilter.
Formalina, peróxido de hidrógeno y antib: Formalin, hydrogen peroxide and antibiotics can temporarily inhibit nitrification. Monitor TAN and nitrite afterwards.
Las nitrificantes crecen lento. Un biofi: Nitrifiers grow slowly. A new biofilter in cold water can take 6 to 10 weeks or more to mature.
Supuestos: todo el NAT excretado se remu: Assumptions: all excreted TAN is removed in the biofilter (conservative). SRR depends on TAN, O₂ and temperature; 0.35 is an example value, use the manufacturer’s value at your temperature. Illustrative defaults, not plant data.
Curva conceptual de un modelo simple (cr: Conceptual curve from a simple model (AOB and NOB growth with a constant TAN load). It shows the sequence: TAN rises first, then nitrite, and finally nitrate stabilizes. It is not a prediction for your plant.
La luz ultravioleta C (200–280 nm) daña: Ultraviolet C light (200–280 nm) damages the DNA and RNA of bacteria, viruses and fungi so they cannot multiply. It adds no chemicals to the water. Después del filtro mecánico y del biofil: After the mechanical filter and the biofilter, before the water returns to the tanks. That way the water arrives clean (high UVT) and light is not wasted on particles. It is also used on the farm’s intake water and on egg water.

Agua turbia o con color (UVT bajo), cuar: Turbid or coloured water (low UVT), dirty quartz, old lamps (they lose 20–30% of output at end of life), flow above design and cold water in low-pressure lamps.
Cuando se usa ozono, el reactor UV va de: When ozone is used, the UV reactor goes after it: UV light breaks down the residual ozone that would remain in the water and is toxic to salmon even at hundredths of a mg/L.
Dosis orientativas de literatura (Liltve: Guideline doses from the literature (Liltved et al. 1995; Øye & Rimstad 2001); they vary with strain, salinity and test method. In salmon RAS it is common to design for ≥ 40 mJ/cm², and for ≥ 100 mJ/cm² when the target includes IPNV.
En un RAS la temperatura del agua se con: In a RAS, water temperature is controlled with heat pumps: they move heat from one water stream to another using a refrigerant that evaporates and condenses in a closed loop. pK₁ ≈ 6,45 y pK₂ ≈ 10,45 a 12 °C. Con pH: pK₁ ≈ 6.45 and pK₂ ≈ 10.45 at 12 °C. With pH between 6 and 8.3 almost all alkalinity is HCO₃⁻, so CO₂ = HCO₃⁻·[H⁺]/K₁: for each unit pH drops, free CO₂ is multiplied by ~10 at the same alkalinity.
pKa = 0,0902 + 2729,92/(T + 273,2) ≈ 9,6: pKa = 0.0902 + 2729.92/(T + 273.2) ≈ 9.67 at 12 °C. Every 0.3 pH units roughly doubles the NH₃ fraction. Salinity slightly raises pKa and reduces NH₃.
NH₄⁺ + 1,83 O₂ + 1,97 HCO₃⁻ → 0,024 C₅H₇: NH₄⁺ + 1.83 O₂ + 1.97 HCO₃⁻ → 0.024 C₅H₇O₂N + 0.976 NO₃⁻ + 2.90 H₂O + 1.86 CO₂
Por gramo de N-NAT: 4,18 g O₂, 7,05 g de: Per gram of TAN-N: 4.18 g O₂, 7.05 g alkalinity (CaCO₃) and 5.85 g CO₂ (Ebeling et al. 2006). Without biomass, the classic theoretical values are 4.57 g O₂ and 7.14 g CaCO₃.
Consume ~0,14 mg O₂ y ~1,8 mg de alcalin: Consumes ~0.14 mg O₂ and ~1.8 mg alkalinity (CaCO₃) per mg Fe²⁺. Fe(OH)₃ forms rust-coloured flocs that settle on gills and on the egg chorion.
En agua dulce oxida nitrito, materia org: In freshwater it oxidizes nitrite, dissolved organic matter and colour. With bromide (brackish water made with sea salt) it forms residual bromine oxidants and bromate, which persist longer than ozone itself.
Solubilidad mínima cerca de pH 6–6,5. El: Minimum solubility near pH 6–6.5. The danger comes when acidic water containing Al mixes or reaches the gill (a more alkaline microenvironment): Al polymerizes and precipitates on the epithelium.
No todas las etapas toleran lo mismo: Not all life stages tolerate the same
Sin branquias: intercambia gases por el: No gills: it exchanges gases through the chorion. Solids, Fe(OH)₃ and precipitates suffocate it. It needs very clean water (< 2 NTU), high O₂ and no residual ozone.
Branquia recién formada, muy sensible a: Newly formed gills, very sensitive to NH₃, metals and supersaturated gas. Calcium in the water matters for osmoregulation.
Mayor tolerancia, pero el CO₂ crónico &g: Higher tolerance, but chronic CO₂ > 15–20 mg/L reduces growth and promotes nephrocalcinosis.
La smoltificación depende de la Na⁺/K⁺-A: Smoltification depends on gill Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase. Labile Al and Cu at µg/L levels can ruin seawater tolerance even without visible mortality.

Los rangos de DBO, turbidez y ORP, y la: The ranges for BOD, turbidity and ORP, and the biofilter surface removal rate, are operational references from the RAS industry, with less experimental support than those for NH₃, CO₂, O₂ or Al. Cu and Al toxicity depends on hardness, pH and dissolved organic carbon, so a single number does not describe it well. For discharges, the Chilean legal framework is D.S. 90/2000 and each farm’s RCA (environmental permit); check the applicable limits there. Every health decision must be validated with the farm’s own data and with the veterinarian.
Guía didáctica de calidad de agua para s: Teaching guide to water quality for salmonids in recirculating aquaculture systems.
Material de apoyo técnico: no reemplaza: Technical support material: it does not replace internal procedures or current regulations.
El teléfono pausó el 3D para ahorrar mem: The phone paused 3D to save memory or battery.
Mide la actividad de iones H⁺ en escala: Measures H⁺ ion activity on a logarithmic scale: pH 6 is ten times more acidic than pH 7. In RAS pH tends to drop because nitrification consumes alkalinity and because fish and the biofilter produce CO₂.
pH bajo (< 6): pérdida de iones por la b: Low pH (< 6): ion loss through the gills (Na⁺, Cl⁻), excess mucus, and it boosts aluminium and CO₂ toxicity.
pH alto (> 8,5): aumenta la fracción NH₃: High pH (> 8.5): raises the NH₃ fraction and damages the gill epithelium; above 9 it can be lethal.
Cambios bruscos (> 0,5 unidades en horas: Sudden changes (> 0.5 units within hours) are more stressful than a stable value slightly out of range.
Subir: bicarbonato de sodio (NaHCO₃, seg: Raise: sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃, safe and slow), caustic soda (NaOH) or hydrated lime with controlled dosing.
Desgasificar CO₂: el pH sube sin agregar: Strip CO₂: pH rises without adding chemicals.
Bajar: rara vez necesario en RAS; reduci: Lower: rarely needed in RAS; reduce base dosing or increase CO₂ in the water.
Ajustar con lazo de control y sonda cali: Adjust with a control loop and a calibrated probe; the biofilter performs best between ~7.0 and 8.0.
Capacidad del agua para neutralizar ácid: The water’s capacity to neutralize acid; in RAS it is almost all bicarbonate (HCO₃⁻). It is the "cushion" that prevents pH drops and the source of inorganic carbon for nitrifying bacteria.
No es tóxica en sí; actúa a través del p: Not toxic in itself; it acts through pH and CO₂.
Con alcalinidad baja el pH oscila y pued: With low alkalinity pH swings and can crash, nitrification slows and TAN rises.
A igual pH, más alcalinidad implica más: At the same pH, more alkalinity means more free CO₂ (carbonate system relationship).
Reponer con NaHCO₃: estequiométricamente: Replenish with NaHCO₃: stoichiometrically up to ~12 g per g of N nitrified; in practice it is dosed per kg of feed and adjusted with measurements.
Reactores de carbonato de calcio o cal e: Calcium carbonate or lime reactors in soft make-up water.
Gas producido por la respiración de pece: Gas produced by fish and bacterial respiration. In RAS it builds up because water recirculates and room ventilation is often limited. It is measured with a probe or calculated from pH, alkalinity and temperature.
Dificulta la excreción de CO₂ por la bra: It hinders CO₂ excretion through the gills (hypercapnia) and acidifies the blood.
Reduce la capacidad de la hemoglobina de: It reduces haemoglobin’s capacity to carry O₂ (Bohr and Root effects).
Crónico > 15–20 mg/L: menor crecimiento: Chronic > 15–20 mg/L: lower growth and appetite, nephrocalcinosis (calcium deposits in the kidney).
Desgasificadores de cascada o columna em: Cascade or packed-column degassers; typical air:water ratio 5:1 to 10:1.
Ventilar la sala: si el aire interior se: Ventilate the room: if indoor air loads up with CO₂, the degasser loses efficiency.
Subir pH con base convierte CO₂ en HCO₃⁻: Raising pH with base turns CO₂ into HCO₃⁻ (it does not remove it from the system, it transforms it).
Oxígeno gaseoso disuelto en el agua. Su: Gaseous oxygen dissolved in water. Its solubility drops with temperature and salinity: ~10.8 mg/L at 12 °C in freshwater. % saturation is the physiologically relevant measure.
< 60 % de saturación: hipoxia, caída del: < 60% saturation: hypoxia, lower feed intake and growth; higher susceptibility to disease.
La salida del estanque es el punto críti: The tank outlet is the critical point: that is where fish breathe the least O₂.
Sobresaturación de gas total (TGP > 102–: Total gas supersaturation (TGP > 102–103%, mainly from N₂) causes gas bubble disease.
Hiperoxia prolongada (> 150 %) reduce la: Prolonged hyperoxia (> 150%) reduces gill ventilation and favours CO₂ retention.
Oxígeno puro con conos, columnas o LHO,: Pure oxygen with cones, columns or LHOs, controlled by an outlet probe.
Ajustar oxigenación a la hora y cantidad: Match oxygenation to feeding time and amount (post-feeding peak).
Desgasificar N₂ en columnas para control: Strip N₂ in columns to control TGP.
No olvidar el consumo del biofiltro y de: Do not forget biofilter and organic matter (BOD) consumption.
Es la suma de las presiones de todos los: It is the sum of the pressures of all gases dissolved in the water (N₂, O₂, argon, CO₂ and water vapour) compared with atmospheric pressure. 100% means equilibrium with air. Above 100% the water is supersaturated and gas tends to come out as bubbles, even inside the fish. It is also expressed as ΔP (mmHg) = gas pressure − barometric pressure.
Enfermedad de la burbuja de gas: burbuja: Gas bubble disease: bubbles in fins, skin, eyes (exophthalmia), gills and blood vessels (embolisms).
Alevines con saco vitelino son los más s: Yolk-sac alevins are the most sensitive: bubbles in the yolk sac, they float and die. Chronic damage from TGP ~102–103%.
Sobre ~110 % se esperan mortalidades agu: Above ~110% acute mortality is expected in juveniles, especially in shallow tanks.
El nitrógeno (N₂ + Ar) es el más peligro: Nitrogen (N₂ + Ar) is the most dangerous because fish do not consume it. A high TGP from O₂ alone is better tolerated.
La profundidad protege: cada metro de ag: Depth protects: each metre of water compensates about 10% supersaturation.
Desgasificar: columnas de relleno, torre: Degas: packed columns, trickling towers or vacuum degassers before the tanks.
Revisar entradas de aire en la succión d: Check for air leaks at pump suction (seals, joints, vortices): air drawn in dissolves under pressure.
Cuidado al calentar el agua o al usar ag: Take care when heating water or using well or spring water: it often comes supersaturated with N₂.
Al inyectar O₂ puro a presión (conos, LH: When injecting pure O₂ under pressure (cones, LHO), check TGP at the outlet and strip N₂ first.
Medir con saturómetro en la entrada del: Measure with a saturometer at the tank inlet and calculate N₂ + Ar %, not just TGP.
Valores orientativos (Colt 1984, 2006; W: Guideline values (Colt 1984, 2006; Weitkamp & Katz 1980). Limits depend on species, life stage, depth and how much of the excess is N₂.
760 mmHg a nivel del mar; baja con la al: 760 mmHg at sea level; it drops with altitude.
Lectura directa del equipo (mmHg sobre l: Direct reading from the instrument (mmHg above atmosphere).
% saturation measured with the oxygen meter.
El nitrógeno es el 78 % del aire y se di: Nitrogen is 78% of air and dissolves in water just like oxygen. The difference is that fish neither consume nor produce it: if extra comes in, it stays. N₂ % shows how much nitrogen (plus argon) is dissolved compared with equilibrium with air. It is not measured directly: it is calculated from the saturometer TGP, oxygen and temperature.
Es el principal responsable de la enferm: It is the main cause of gas bubble disease: above 100% it forms bubbles in blood and tissues.
Daño crónico en alevines con saco viteli: Chronic damage in yolk-sac alevins from ~102–103%; acute mortality in juveniles above ~107–110%.
Un TGP de 105 % con N₂ de 100 % (exceso: A TGP of 105% with N₂ at 100% (excess from O₂ only) is much less risky than a TGP of 105% with N₂ at 106%.
Bajo 100 % no causa daño: al oxigenar co: Below 100% it causes no harm: oxygenating with pure O₂ usually lowers N₂, which leaves a safety margin.
Desgasificar con columnas de relleno, to: Degas with packed columns, trickling towers or vacuum: N₂ leaves when water contacts air or pure O₂.
Oxigenadores de baja presión (LHO) despl: Low-head oxygenators (LHO) strip N₂ while adding O₂.
Eliminar entradas de aire en la succión: Eliminate air leaks at pump suctions and pressurized pipes.
Desgasificar siempre el agua de pozo, de: Always degas well, spring or heated water before using it.
Valores orientativos (Colt 1984; Weitkam: Guideline values (Colt 1984; Weitkamp & Katz 1980). Use the calculator in the TGP fact sheet or the simulator at the top to get N₂ % from your measurements.
El NAT (nitrógeno amoniacal total) es la: TAN (total ammonia nitrogen) is the sum of NH₄⁺ and NH₃. Salmon excrete it through the gills as a product of protein metabolism. The uncharged NH₃ form crosses membranes and is the toxic one; its share depends on pH and temperature.
Hiperplasia y lesiones branquiales, meno: Gill hyperplasia and lesions, lower growth and lower resistance to pathogens.
Altera la excreción de amoníaco propio y: It disrupts excretion of the fish’s own ammonia and neurological function at high exposures.
Toxicidad aguda en salmónidos desde ~0,0: Acute toxicity in salmonids from ~0.08 mg/L NH₃ according to the literature (LC50 highly variable).
En RAS el NAT normal se mantiene bajo 1–: In RAS, normal TAN is kept below 1–2 mg/L N.
Biofiltro (MBBR, lecho fijo) dimensionad: Biofilter (MBBR, fixed bed) sized for daily TAN production; keep O₂, pH and alkalinity right for nitrifiers.
Evitar alzas bruscas de pH, sobre todo a: Avoid sudden pH rises, especially when dosing base.
Reducir o suspender alimentación ante al: Reduce or stop feeding when TAN rises.
Recambio de agua. La zeolita intercambia: Water exchange. Zeolite exchanges NH₄⁺ in freshwater, but loses capacity with salinity.
Equivale a ~0,015 / 0,030 mg/L expresado: Equivalent to ~0.015 / 0.030 mg/L expressed as NH₃ (factor 17/14). Check which form your lab reports.
Oxígeno que consumen las bacterias al de: Oxygen consumed by bacteria while breaking down organic matter over 5 days at 20 °C. In RAS it comes from faeces, uneaten feed and fines. It is an indicator of organic load, not a direct toxicant.
Consume O₂ que debería ir a los peces y: It consumes O₂ that should go to the fish and the biofilter.
Favorece bacterias heterótrofas que comp: It favours heterotrophic bacteria that compete with nitrifiers and may include opportunists (Flavobacterium, among others).
Se asocia a más sólidos finos, turbidez: It goes with more fine solids, turbidity and higher ozone demand.
Retirar sólidos rápido: filtro de tambor: Remove solids quickly: drum filter (40–100 µm), protein skimmer, bottom purges.
Ajustar ración para evitar alimento no c: Adjust rations to avoid uneaten feed; use pellets with good water stability.
Ozono en dosis bajas oxida materia orgán: Low-dose ozone oxidizes dissolved organic matter.
Limpiar sumideros y zonas muertas donde: Clean sumps and dead zones where sludge builds up.
Referencia operativa de cultivo, no lími: Operational culture reference, not a discharge limit.
Mide cuánta luz dispersan las partículas: Measures how much light suspended particles scatter (fine solids, bacteria, iron flocs). It is related to total suspended solids (TSS), although the equivalence depends on the type of particle.
Irrita y obstruye la branquia; en ovas,: It irritates and clogs the gills; on eggs, settled solids reduce O₂ exchange and hatching.
Baja la transmitancia UV: con agua turbi: It lowers UV transmittance: in turbid water UV disinfects much less.
Señal temprana de mala remoción de sólid: Early sign of poor solids removal or a biofilter sloughing biomass.
Filtro de tambor y fraccionador de espum: Drum filter and protein skimmer; sand or cartridge filters in incubation.
Ozono: microflocula partículas finas que: Ozone: micro-flocculates fine particles that the skimmer then removes.
Revisar purgas, sedimentadores y lavado: Check purges, settlers and filter backwashing.
Referencia operativa. En SST, Thorarense: Operational reference. For TSS, Thorarensen & Farrell (2011) suggest keeping it below ~15 mg/L for post-smolts.
Medir: mensual / cambio de fuente: Measure: monthly / when the source changes
Concentración de calcio y magnesio, expr: Calcium and magnesium concentration, expressed as CaCO₃. It is different from alkalinity, although in many waters they go together. Many surface water sources in southern Chile are soft.
El Ca²⁺ estabiliza las uniones del epite: Ca²⁺ stabilizes the junctions of the gill epithelium and reduces ion loss.
Agua blanda (< 20 mg/L) aumenta mucho la: Soft water (< 20 mg/L) greatly increases the toxicity of copper, aluminium and other metals.
Influye en el endurecimiento de la ova y: It affects egg water-hardening and alevin osmoregulation.
Cloruro de calcio (CaCl₂) o carbonato de: Calcium chloride (CaCl₂) or calcium carbonate in the make-up water.
Sal marina aporta Ca y Mg; la sal refina: Sea salt adds Ca and Mg; refined salt (pure NaCl) adds no hardness.
Metal que llega desde cañerías, válvulas: Metal that comes from bronze or copper-nickel pipes, valves or heat exchangers, algicides and some treatments. The toxic form is free Cu²⁺, which increases with low pH, soft water and little organic matter.
Daño branquial e inhibición de la Na⁺/K⁺: Gill damage and inhibition of Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase: osmoregulation failure.
En smolts compromete la tolerancia al ag: In smolts it compromises seawater tolerance at sublethal concentrations.
Afecta el olfato y las respuestas de com: It affects smell and behavioural responses.
No usar cobre ni bronce en contacto con: Do not use copper or bronze in contact with culture water; check heat exchangers.
Subir dureza y alcalinidad reduce la fra: Raising hardness and alkalinity reduces the free fraction.
Quelación con EDTA o filtración por carb: Chelation with EDTA or filtration through activated carbon / resins on the intake water.
Barra para agua blanda. Con dureza > 100: Bar for soft water. With hardness > 100 mg/L CaCO₃ the thresholds rise roughly 2–3 times.
Frecuente en agua de pozo como Fe²⁺ disu: Common in well water as dissolved, invisible Fe²⁺. On contact with O₂ or ozone it oxidizes to Fe³⁺ and precipitates as ferric hydroxide, a rust-coloured floc.
El Fe(OH)₃ cubre branquias y el corion d: Fe(OH)₃ coats gills and the egg chorion: suffocation and lower hatching.
Promueve ferrobacterias que tapan cañerí: It promotes iron bacteria that clog pipes, diffusers and incubation trays.
It consumes O₂ and alkalinity as it oxidizes.
Oxidar antes de usar: aireación, oxígeno: Oxidize before use: aeration, oxygen, ozone or permanganate.
Retener el precipitado: sedimentación y: Retain the precipitate: settling and sand or greensand filters.
Subir el pH acelera la oxidación del Fe²: Raising pH speeds up Fe²⁺ oxidation.
El aluminio inorgánico (lábil) es la fra: Inorganic (labile) aluminium is the toxic fraction. It is mobilized when intake water acidifies, for example with heavy rain, or by carry-over of coagulants (aluminium sulphate, PAC) used in treatment.
Se acumula y polimeriza en la branquia:: It accumulates and polymerizes on the gills: mucus, hypoxia and ion loss.
En smolts, exposiciones a pocos µg/L red: In smolts, exposures of a few µg/L reduce seawater tolerance and later survival (Kroglund et al. 2008).
Más tóxico entre pH 5,0 y 6,5 y en agua: Most toxic between pH 5.0 and 6.5 and in soft water; mixing zones of waters with different pH are especially dangerous.
Agregar silicato o Ca ayuda a reducir la: Adding silicate or Ca helps reduce toxicity.
Evitar residuos de coagulantes de alumin: Avoid aluminium coagulant residues in the make-up water.
Oxidante muy fuerte que se dosifica en R: Very strong oxidant dosed in RAS to oxidize organic matter, nitrite and colour, and to improve UV efficiency. It is controlled indirectly with ORP (oxidation-reduction potential).
El residual en el agua de peces debe ser: The residual in fish water must be practically zero: it damages the gills at hundredths of a mg/L.
Bien dosificado mejora la claridad, baja: Well dosed, it improves clarity, lowers BOD and nitrite and reduces the bacterial load.
En agua con bromuro forma oxidantes de b: In water with bromide it forms bromine oxidants and bromate, which persist and are toxic.
Dosis típica 10–25 g O₃ por kg de alimen: Typical dose 10–25 g O₃ per kg of feed, applied in a contact reactor outside the tank.
Destruir el residual antes de los peces:: Destroy the residual before the fish: UV, degassing or contact time.
Control por ORP en lazo cerrado con alar: Closed-loop ORP control with a shut-off alarm.
Con agua salobre de sal marina, monitore: With brackish water made from sea salt, monitor total residual oxidants.
Barra de ORP en agua dulce. A 3 ppt con: ORP bar for freshwater. At 3 ppt with sea salt there is ~5–6 mg/L bromide: ORP no longer indicates ozone alone.

Bajo esta profundidad el gas ya no forma: Below this depth the gas no longer forms bubbles.
El salmón excreta ~9,2 % de la proteína: Salmon excrete ~9.2% of ingested protein as TAN (Timmons & Ebeling).
Respiración: ~1,4 g de CO₂ por g de O₂ c: Respiration: ~1.4 g CO₂ per g O₂ consumed.
Consumo de O₂ por los peces, con pico de: O₂ consumption by fish, peaking after feeding.
Heces y pellet no consumido aportan mate: Faeces and uneaten pellets add organic matter.
Más CO₂ disuelto forma ácido carbónico y: More dissolved CO₂ forms carbonic acid and lowers pH.
Fisiológico: el CO₂ alto reduce el trans: Physiological: high CO₂ reduces O₂ transport in the blood (Bohr and Root effects).
Amortigua: sostiene el pH frente al ácid: Buffers: holds pH against the acid produced.
A igual pH, más alcalinidad significa má: At the same pH, more alkalinity means more free CO₂.
Fuente de carbono inorgánico para nitrif: Source of inorganic carbon for nitrifiers; below ~70 mg/L they struggle.
Los carbonatos complejan el Cu²⁺ y reduc: Carbonates complex Cu²⁺ and reduce its free fraction.
Cada +0,3 de pH duplica aproximadamente: Every +0.3 pH roughly doubles the NH₃ fraction.
Subir el pH sobre 6,5 reduce el Al lábil: Raising pH above 6.5 reduces labile Al; the worst zone is pH 5–6.5.
At higher pH free Cu²⁺ decreases.
La nitrificación es más rápida entre ~7: Nitrification is fastest between ~7 and 8; below 6.5 it drops sharply.
Baja la solubilidad del O₂ y aumenta el: Lowers O₂ solubility and increases metabolic demand.
Más temperatura acelera la nitrificación: Higher temperature speeds up nitrification within the culture range.
Al calentar el agua baja la solubilidad: Heating water lowers gas solubility: the same dissolved gas becomes supersaturation.
Inyectar O₂ puro a presión sube la presi: Injecting pure O₂ under pressure raises total pressure if N₂ is not stripped first.
Oxidizes TAN to nitrite and nitrate.
Consume 7,05 g CaCO₃ por g de N nitrific: Consumes 7.05 g CaCO₃ per g of N nitrified.
Consume 4,18 g O₂ por g de N nitrificado: Consumes 4.18 g O₂ per g of N nitrified.
Produce 5,85 g CO₂ por g de N nitrificad: Produces 5.85 g CO₂ per g of N nitrified.
Las nitrificantes necesitan O₂ (> ~4 mg/: Nitrifiers need O₂ (> ~4 mg/L in the biofilter).
Bacterias heterótrofas consumen O₂ al de: Heterotrophic bacteria consume O₂ while breaking down organic matter.
Heterótrofas compiten con nitrificantes: Heterotrophs compete with nitrifiers for space and O₂.
Materia orgánica particulada y biomasa b: Particulate organic matter and suspended bacterial biomass.
El Ca²⁺ compite en la branquia y reduce: Ca²⁺ competes at the gill and reduces Cu toxicity.
El Ca²⁺ protege el epitelio frente al Al: Ca²⁺ protects the epithelium against Al.
La oxidación del Fe²⁺ consume ~0,14 mg O: Fe²⁺ oxidation consumes ~0.14 mg O₂/mg Fe.
La oxidación libera H⁺: ~1,8 mg CaCO₃/mg: Oxidation releases H⁺: ~1.8 mg CaCO₃/mg Fe.
Microfloculación: las partículas finas s: Micro-flocculation: fine particles aggregate and are removed.
Oxidizes Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺ so it can be filtered.

El medio ocupa solo una parte para poder: Media fills only part of it so it can move (max. ~67–70%).
Cuánto NAT debe bajar el agua cada vez q: How much TAN the water must drop each time it crosses the biofilter to remove all production.
Si el porcentaje es alto, el NAT del sis: If the percentage is high, system TAN will rise until removal matches production. More flow reduces the demand per pass.
El NaHCO₃ real suele ser menor porque el: Real NaHCO₃ use is usually lower because water exchange adds alkalinity.
La tasa volumétrica calculada con el vol: The volumetric rate calculated from volume must match SRR × SSA × fill.

Cómo se genera y se inyecta el ozono: How ozone is generated and injected
El ozono (O₃) no se puede guardar: se fa: Ozone (O₃) cannot be stored: it is made on the spot from oxygen with a high-voltage electrical discharge. It is then mixed with the water in a venturi injector and reacts in a contact column. Follow the molecules: O₂ (two red spheres) enters the generator and part of it leaves as O₃ (three light-blue spheres).
No se pudo cargar el motor 3D (Three.js): The 3D engine (Three.js) could not be loaded. The ozone simulator works the same.
Gas que entra al generador, desde el con: Gas entering the generator, from the concentrator or the O₂ tank.
% en peso. Sube con más potencia y menos: % by weight. It rises with more power and less flow; with air instead of O₂ it only reaches 1–3%.
Fracción del ozono que se disuelve. El r: Share of the ozone that dissolves. The rest leaves as gas to the destructor.
La dosis en RAS se expresa por kg de ali: In RAS the dose is expressed per kg of feed.
Agua que pasa por el inyector y la colum: Water passing through the injector and the contact column.
O₃ (g/h) = flujo de O₂ (L/min) × 60 × 1,: O₃ (g/h) = O₂ flow (L/min) × 60 × 1.429 g/L × concentration (%)  ·  Dose (g/kg) = O₃ (g/h) × 24 × efficiency ÷ feed (kg/d)
En RAS de salmón se suele trabajar con <: Salmon RAS usually work with 10–25 g O₃ per kg of feed. An oxygen-fed generator uses about 7–12 kWh per kg of O₃. Real control is done with ORP (250–350 mV) and an alarm that shuts the generator off.
Modelo simplificado para aprender. El oz: Simplified model for learning. Residual ozone in fish water must be practically zero.
Entre dos electrodos separados por un di: Thousands of volts are applied between two electrodes separated by a dielectric (glass or ceramic). The discharge splits O₂ molecules into oxygen atoms (O), which join another O₂ to form O₃. Almost all the energy becomes heat, which is why the cell is water-cooled.
El gas debe ser muy seco (punto de rocío: The gas must be very dry (dew point below −60 °C). With moisture, nitric acid forms that corrodes the cell and lowers output. That is why O₂ from a PSA concentrator or a liquid oxygen tank is used.
El <b>venturi</b> crea una zona de baja: The venturi creates a low-pressure zone that draws in the gas without a compressor. The contact column then gives time (1–4 min) for the ozone to dissolve and oxidize organic matter, nitrite and colour.
El ozono gaseoso es tóxico para las pers: Ozone gas is toxic to people (exposure limit ~0.1 ppm). The room needs an ambient ozone detector, undissolved gas goes through a catalytic or thermal destructor, and the water passes through UV or degassing before reaching the fish.
